method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited texts, seat-neutral core with regulative rules where the text states duties, and a seat layer for the individual applying for or receiving Saskatchewan Income Support, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE (a lump-sum case where the s 3-3(1) formula has no meaning answers NOTHING, asserted); the benefit amounts left to the minister's schedule of rates are an input; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
